challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Casey's repeated initiation and approximately weekly one-on-one planning over twelve weeks provide substantial evidence of sustained relational interest, reducing confidence in B.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner show effort and responsiveness to Drew's priorities, supporting A.
Casey's independent resumption of regular contact after time apart indicates continuity of interest rather than purely passive involvement, supporting A.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B is retained narrowly. C2-F1, C2-F2, and C2-F3 establish meaningful interest and some investment, but C2-F4, C2-F5, and C2-F6 more directly indicate limited commitment: Casey repeatedly avoided defining the relationship, offered no timeline, often favored short-notice or nearby meetings, canceled advance plans for other commitments, did not introduce Drew to close contacts, and declined planning two months ahead.
